text: The universe has many stars, but in my universe there is only one.
If I had to be born as food, I would choose something sweet.
You make ordinary days feel a little less ordinary.
Emergency reminder: you are very, very loved.
Please accept this tiny note as a hug.
I hope something nice surprises you today.
You are allowed to take up all the space in my heart.
Sweets taste better when you are happy.
